# Plan: ISSUE-199 role-run telemetry

**Shape: Involved.** Add observation and persistence across adapters, sandbox lifecycle, workflow artifacts, status projections, and PR evidence without changing execution policy or approval authority.

Maintainers will get one row per role execution, with measured lifecycle costs and whatever usage the harness actually reports. Existing provenance and artifact formats remain compatible through additive fields.

## What we know

- `internal/agent/runner.go:27` has no usage or timing in `RunResult`; `internal/agent/adapters.go:51` labels unspecified configured models `default`, which is not an observed model.
- `internal/workflow/engine.go:772,796,800` uses one planner invocation for two artifacts. `runMetadata` (`internal/workflow/guidance.go:38`) centralizes metadata for planner, developer and tester, but reviewer metadata is assembled separately (`engine.go:1264`).
- `internal/agent/review.go:31` creates a reviewer snapshot before invoking the adapter. Native/delegated runs also prepare detached workspaces (`internal/sandbox/native.go:306`); timing only `Runner.Run` would miss the outer reviewer snapshot.
- `RunNativeCodex` (`internal/sandbox/native.go:263`) and `RunDelegatedHarness` (`internal/sandbox/delegated.go:94`) perform preflight, prepare workspaces, and run follow-up turns. Current stdout/stderr capture combines channels (`internal/agent/isolated.go:39`), unsuitable for blindly treating all output as structured events.
- Artifact metadata is string-valued and extensible (`internal/contract/types.go:72`, `internal/contract/artifact.schema.json`). No protected schema or config change is needed.
- Artifacts are replaced by type (`internal/lease/manager.go:1695`), and attestations by role (`manager.go:464`); neither alone retains per-run history. Metadata must carry each run, with a small additive state history for prior executions.
- Issue JSON wraps `issueStatus` (`internal/cli/status.go:16`); PR JSON serializes `internal/pr/service.go:66`'s `Result`. Existing status output and provenance are tested in `TestCLIStatusProvenance` and `TestCLIPRWorkValidateSubmitPreservesIdentity`.
- `make check` runs formatting checks, vet, staticcheck, and `go test -race ./...` (Makefile). The operator allows at most one full suite.

## What we're assuming

- Qualified Claude and Codex headless CLIs offer structured usage events. Confirm their installed `--help` and existing qualification fixtures before choosing exact flags; parse fixture-defined fields only. No OpenAI product/API assumptions are required for this repository change.
- Existing metadata transport can accommodate a bounded scalar telemetry object serialized as one string. Check fork admission size limits and normal artifact validation using local fixtures before finalizing encoding.

## Open questions

- Which qualified Claude/Codex event fields expose actual model, effort and usage, and do token totals cover a turn or a session? Resolve in step 1 with help output and sanitized fixtures. Missing fields stay unavailable; no paid or live session is required.
- Harnesses may expose model/API duration but not exclusive tool duration. Record the reported metric with its definition; never derive model time by subtracting tool time from elapsed time. Unsupported timing stays unavailable.
- This detached planning workspace has no Git metadata (`git status` reports no repository). Tests requiring repository ancestry must run in the implementing checkout/CI, not become a prerequisite for writing this plan.

## Design and boundaries

Use a typed `contract.RoleRunTelemetry` shared by agent, sandbox, lease and projections. Store a versioned JSON encoding under artifact metadata key `role_run_telemetry`; add `IssueState.RoleRuns` as the fenced history needed when an artifact is superseded or a run fails. Use a coordinator-generated opaque run ID, role, harness, outcome, start timestamp, elapsed milliseconds, setup/preflight/snapshot milliseconds, optional reported model/tool milliseconds, input/output/cached-input token counts, tool-call and repeated-command counts, repair/re-plan counters, actual model and effort. Numeric pointers and nullable strings encode unavailable explicitly as JSON null; measured zero remains zero. Keep requested/configured model in existing provenance separately. Include observation source/coverage so partial output is not presented as a complete count.

Each actual `Runner.Run` gets one ID, reused for both planner artifacts. Keep per-run history distinct from the latest-per-role attestations. Persist through the existing claim-fenced artifact/state mutation path, never through agent-written files or comments. For an error before an artifact can be produced, record the available run observation through a dedicated fenced lease method and the existing validated fork update-artifact transport using a valid role artifact when appropriate; if that transport cannot represent failure without changing gate semantics, add a dedicated telemetry operation consistently to operation/transport/admission lists and synchronization tests. Telemetry must never create an approval or passing validation. Prefer no new fork operation if the existing path suffices; settle this in step 1 and document in IMPLEMENTATION.md.

Repeated commands mean additional occurrences of an identical structured shell command payload within this run, counted in memory; retain only counts, never commands or their hashes. Tool calls count starts once, excluding completion echoes. Repair/re-plan counters describe coordinator-selected attempts (initial=0), not inferred agent thoughts or tool retries. Multi-turn reported usage is accumulated only when event semantics prove values are per turn; cumulative totals are not summed twice. No token estimate, model selection change, prompt change, new credential access, boundary weakening, or PR merge timing.

Supported observation paths: mock; trusted-local adapters; native Codex; delegated Claude; existing OCI worker timing. Other harnesses and interactive runs retain elapsed/lifecycle observations where available and explicit null usage. No new platform or runtime prerequisite; native/OCI boundary integration remains conditional on its current prerequisites.

## Implementation sequence and exact touchpoints

1. Establish fixture semantics and the additive contract. Create `internal/contract/telemetry.go` and `telemetry_test.go`; extend `internal/agent/runner.go` with telemetry. Define validation, units, null handling, bounded model/effort labels, versioning and deterministic serialization. Reject malformed/negative/overflow values; unrecognized or missing events yield unavailable. Resolve failure persistence transport before adding callers.
2. Add `internal/agent/telemetry.go`, `telemetry_test.go`, and sanitized `internal/agent/testdata/telemetry/` Claude/Codex fixtures. Update `CLIAdapter.BuildCommand`, `CLIAdapter.Run`, `MockRunner.Run` in `adapters.go`, and `runIsolated` in `isolated.go`. Observe bounded stdout event streams separately from stderr; retain compatible human diagnostics/report handling. Explicitly avoid parsing arbitrary prose as telemetry or serializing raw events. Mock uses deterministic fixture values, while real elapsed times are measured.
3. Instrument owned lifecycle stages with a typed optional observer in `internal/sandbox/worker.go`'s `WorkerOptions`; update `native.go` (`RunNativeCodex`, `withNativeWorkspace`), `delegated.go` (`RunDelegatedHarness`), and `worker.go` (`RunWorker`). Update `internal/agent/review.go:RunReview` to merge outer snapshot duration without double counting. Stream callbacks must be concurrency-safe and bounded. Keep existing sandbox flags and output import rules; only enable verified structured-output flags. Update matching harness docs if invocation flags change.
4. Route metadata/history consistently: extend `internal/workflow/guidance.go:runMetadata`; update planner/developer/tester and reviewer paths in `engine.go`, including errors and automatic re-plan attempts. Update `internal/pr/resolve.go` and `rebase_plan.go` repair invocations. Record repair context at those coordinator call sites. Extend `internal/lease/manager.go:IssueState`, `updateArtifact` and a fenced run-record method as needed; add `internal/lease/telemetry.go` for validated merge/dedup/projection. Deduplicate by run ID, preserve history across artifact replacement, and scope history to task/claim context rather than silently relabeling prior runs. Audit clear/carry/reset paths to keep their current authority semantics. Update `internal/cli/stage.go` so manual staging reports unavailable observation instead of inventing an execution; preserve tester telemetry on validation reuse (`internal/lease/validation_guidance.go` if needed). No changes to artifact bodies or review binding digests.
5. Add shared rows/formatting in `internal/lease/telemetry.go` (plain text and Markdown) and additive `role_runs` in issueStatus and PR Result. Update `internal/cli/status.go`, `internal/cli/pr.go`, `internal/pr/service.go:Status`, `internal/cli/submit.go`'s PR evidence builder, and `internal/lease/manager.go:BuildProvenanceAttestation`/living comment projection. Rows show role/run, elapsed and lifecycle milliseconds, reported model/tool milliseconds, token triple, calls/repeats, repair/re-plan, actual model/effort. Use `unavailable` in text and null in JSON. Preserve JSON envelopes and legacy provenance. PR evidence includes the same rows and machine-readable observations. Escape display fields and bound labels before rendering.
6. Update the compatibility assertions listed below, add `changes/unreleased/199-role-run-telemetry.md` following neighboring fragments, and document behavior in the listed docs. Developer records final choices, supported event versions, failure/history handling and deviations in `.swarm/active/IMPLEMENTATION.md`; tester records commands, results and skipped environment checks in `.swarm/active/VALIDATION.md`.
7. Run focused verification then one `make check` as specified in TEST_PLAN.md. Do not edit protected paths; if verified CLI output requires changing qualification policy rather than flags alone, report that gap for review instead of expanding this WorkUnit.

## Existing format assertions and call sites: planned updates

| Existing surface found before planning | Planned update |
| --- | --- |
| `internal/contract/attestation_test.go:TestRoleAttestationMetadataKeepsBaseAndSkipsEmptyFields`; `parser_test.go:TestValidateArtifact` | Preserve old provenance behavior; assert telemetry string round-trip and optional legacy records. |
| `internal/agent/adapters_test.go:TestConfiguredModelReachesSupportedHarness`, `TestAgentModelHelper`, environment tests | Update exact argv only for verified structured flags; retain configured model and credential assertions. |
| `internal/agent/review_test.go:TestRunReviewPreservesOriginalOnHostileSuccessAndFailure`, snapshot limits and timeout recovery tests | Assert snapshot telemetry survives success/failure while retaining all isolation assertions. |
| `internal/sandbox/native_test.go` native workspace/import/boundary tests; `harness_integration_test.go` delegated qualification/tool tests; `worker_test.go` | Update invocation expectations and lifecycle observer tests; retain capability and import restrictions. |
| `internal/workflow/engine.go` planner/developer/tester/reviewer metadata paths; `engine_test.go`, `implementation_test.go`, `revision_plan_test.go`, `claim_budget_test.go` | Assert all roles, shared planner ID, retries, failed/cancelled runs, metadata/history agreement and no duplicate reused execution. |
| `internal/pr/resolve.go`, `rebase_plan.go`; `resolve_test.go`, `rebase_plan_test.go`, `service_test.go` | Attach repair telemetry, preserve original PR identity and expose rows through Status. |
| `internal/lease/manager.go:updateArtifact`, `RecordRoleAttestation`, `BuildProvenanceAttestation`; `manager_test.go:TestLivingCommentProjectionAndPIIFreeProvenance`; `carry_test.go`, `plan_replan_test.go`, `validation_reuse_test.go` | Preserve latest artifact semantics; add deduplicated run history, old-state compatibility, fencing, safe projection, retry and reuse assertions. |
| `internal/cli/cli_test.go:TestCLIStatusProvenance`, `TestCLIInteractiveStageProvenanceAndPlanCommand`; `native_integration_test.go` | Extend text/JSON/evidence expectations; keep listing compact and manual telemetry unavailable. |
| `internal/cli/pr_test.go:TestCLIPRWorkValidateSubmitPreservesIdentity`, interactive staging tests; `pr_resolve_test.go` | Assert matching issue/PR rows and PR evidence, including repair and unavailable values. |
| `internal/cli/status.go:issueStatus/newStatusCmd`, `pr.go` common operation renderer, `submit.go` evidence builder | Add fields/table while preserving envelopes, existing headers, head-fencing and explicit publication. |
| `docs/harness/README.md:65`, `docs/harness/codex.md:24`, `docs/harness/claude.md`; `docs/WORKFLOWS.md` status/provenance discussion; README CLI table/status paragraph | Explain observed metrics, unavailable values and per-run rows; update exact harness invocations only if changed, preserve visuals and real flags. |

Alternatives considered: extending only RoleAttestation loses retries and conflates two planner artifacts; parsing free-text logs guesses metrics and risks exposing commands; external tracing adds infrastructure and credentials. Small typed observations attached to the existing artifact/lease flow meet this WorkUnit directly. No follow-up feature is required for unsupported harness metrics: they remain unavailable.

## Operator guidance

> Planner: before planning, search for existing tests, docs and call sites that assert the status/artifact formats you change, and list each with its planned update. Developer: notes in IMPLEMENTATION.md. Tester: results in VALIDATION.md. Run fast fmt/vet/staticcheck on changed packages and targeted tests; at most one full suite.
